templates.name: Security Headers Bundle
templates.code:
when HTTP_RESPONSE {
    # HSTS - 1 yıl HTTPS zorunluluğu
    HTTP::header insert "Strict-Transport-Security" "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload"
    # Clickjacking koruması
    HTTP::header insert "X-Frame-Options" "SAMEORIGIN"
    # MIME sniffing koruması
    HTTP::header insert "X-Content-Type-Options" "nosniff"
    # Eski tarayıcı XSS filtresi
    HTTP::header insert "X-XSS-Protection" "1; mode=block"
    # Referrer kısıtlama
    HTTP::header insert "Referrer-Policy" "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    # Permissions Policy
    HTTP::header insert "Permissions-Policy" "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
}

templates.name: Server Header Gizleme
Request Header Ekleme
templates.code:
when HTTP_REQUEST {
    # Client IP backend'e ilet
    HTTP::header insert "X-Real-IP" [IP::client_addr]
    HTTP::header insert "X-Forwarded-For" [IP::client_addr]
    HTTP::header insert "X-Forwarded-Proto" "https"
    # VS adı debug için
    HTTP::header insert "X-BIG-IP-VS" [virtual name]
}
